instruction.text: Niran has 35 sweets. He shares them equally between 5 friends. How many sweets does each friend get?
Iris has 50 marbles. She shares them equally between 10 friends. How many marbles does each friend get?
Elijah buys 16 oranges. He shares them equally between his 2 parents. How many oranges does each parent get?
Lucia puts away 18 books. She shares them equally between 2 shelves. How many books does she put on each shelf?
Dohyun makes 20 pancakes. He shares them equally between his 5 family members. How many pancakes does each family member get?
Ramona hands out 30 sheets of paper. She shares them out equally between her 10 classmates. How many sheets of paper does each classmate get?
Casper puts up 12 posters. He shares them equally between 2 rooms. How many posters does he put in each room?
Freya has 15 carrots. She shares them equally between 5 horses. How many carrots does each horse get?
